answer: The comet index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1268 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ridge. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the ivory queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. The fee repeats 12 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
